nodes.title: Embedding of a 2-local term into $n$ qubits

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the ground energy of a Hermitian $2^n \times 2^n$ complex matrix $H$ is the smallest eigenvalue of $H$.
nodes.title: Ground energy of a Hermitian matrix

nodes.summary: For a number $n$ of qubits and a list $h_1, \dots, h_m$ of 2-local terms, the Hamiltonian is the $2^n \times 2^n$ complex matrix $\tilde h_1 + \dots + \tilde h_m$, where $\tilde h_l$ is the embedding of $h_l$ into $n$ qubits; for the empty list it is the zero matrix.
nodes.title: Hamiltonian of a list of 2-local terms

nodes.summary: A bitstring $x$ is a yes-instance when decoding it under the canonical bitstring encoding gives a tuple $(n, (h_1, \dots, h_m), a, b)$ of a natural number $n$, a list of 2-local terms $h_1, \dots, h_m$ and two encoded rational numbers, whose values we also write $a$ and $b$, such that every $h_l$ is valid on $n$ qubits, $b - a \ge 1/(m + 1)$, and the Hamiltonian $H$ of $h_1, \dots, h_m$ on $n$ qubits is Hermitian…

nodes.summary: The 2-local Hamiltonian promise problem, given by its yes-instances and no-instances, is in QMA, and every promise problem in QMA whose sets of yes-instances and no-instances are disjoint sets of bitstrings has a polynomial-time reduction to it.
nodes.title: The 2-local Hamiltonian problem is QMA-complete

nodes.summary: A 2-local term acting on qubits $i$ and $j$ with entry list $e$ is valid on $n$ qubits when $i < j < n$, the list $e$ has exactly $16$ entries, each entry has nonzero denominators in the encodings of both its real and its imaginary part, the $4 \times 4$ complex matrix $M$ encoded by $e$ is positive semidefinite, and $\sum_{p, q} |M_{pq}|^2 \le 1$, that is, $M$ has Frobenius norm at most $1$.
nodes.title: Valid 2-local Hamiltonian term

nodes.summary: A 2-local Hamiltonian term is encoded as a triple $(i, j, e)$ of natural numbers $i$ and $j$, the qubits it acts on, and a list $e$ of pairs of encoded rational numbers, the real and imaginary parts of the entries of its $4 \times 4$ matrix in row-major order.
nodes.title: Encoded 2-local Hamiltonian term

nodes.summary: A promise problem $(Y_1, N_1)$, given by sets $Y_1$ and $N_1$ of bitstrings, reduces to another such promise problem $(Y_2, N_2)$ when there is a polynomial-time computable map $f$ from bitstrings to bitstrings with $f(x) \in Y_2$ for every $x \in Y_1$ and $f(x) \in N_2$ for every $x \in N_1$.
nodes.title: Polynomial-time reduction between promise problems

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
